params.body:
On a report's page, the way to read it was easy to miss.

- **The button.** "Read the report" (or "Read the preview") carried `btn-lg`, a class that was never defined, so it rendered at the size of every other button. It was also green on the dark band, which gives little contrast. `btn-lg` now exists (larger text and padding), and on the dark band the button is white with dark text (`btn-light`). The icon is a page of text (`fa-file-lines`, already in the icon subset) instead of the full-screen arrows.
- **The cover.** The cover is the largest thing on the page and already opened the report, but nothing said so. It now carries a white "Read the report" label in its bottom corner, clear of the report's own title, and the label turns mint on hover.

Checked in a local site with Going Out Staying In, at desktop and phone width. Report tests 35/35.
params.title: Report page: make reading the report easy to find
